description: Land Title Settlement Dept- Nivithigala, Nivithigala D/S/D, Ratnapura District (25/0002)
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal declaration by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement regarding the determination of title for a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 1:71, Block 2). It contains detailed land particulars such as location, extent, owner's name, and the class of title, and is published under the "PART III - LANDS" section and the Registration of Title Act. This fits the definition of a Land Gazette (Type 4), which covers land registrations, title settlements, and property ownership matters.
